scenario: The ego car travels straight in the middle lane while a lead object enters from the right and moves across the lane.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward within the middle lane.

adversarials.behavior: The car enters the ego lane from the right and moves across the lane ahead of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: On a multi-lane straight road, the ego car is positioned in the middle lane while an adversarial car approaches from the right side and crosses into the ego's lane path.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must spawn a set distance behind the adversarial entry point, and the scenario terminates once the ego has passed the point where the adversarial vehicle crossed.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the centered car from first-person perspective; one adversarial car enters from right. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initially ego approaches straight, adversarial is on right; midpoint adversarial enters lane and crosses ahead; ending ego continues past crossing point. 4. Evidence: adversarial's lateral position shifts from right side into and across ego lane while ego maintains constant forward vector.
